competitorDialog.title: Enable Competitor Analysis?
competitorDialog.description: Enhance your roadmap with insights from competitor products

whatItDoes.title: What competitor analysis does:
whatItDoes.item1: Identifies 3-5 main competitors based on your project type
whatItDoes.item2: Searches app stores, forums, and social media for user feedback and pain points
whatItDoes.item3: Suggests features that address gaps in competitor products

privacy.title: Web searches will be performed
privacy.description: This feature will perform web searches to gather competitor information. Your project name and type will be used in search queries. No code or sensitive data is shared.

competitorDialog.optionalInfo: You can generate a roadmap without competitor analysis if you prefer. The roadmap will still be based on your project structure and best practices.

existingCompetitorDialog.title: Competitor Analysis Options
existingCompetitorDialog.description: This project has an existing competitor analysis from {{date}}

useExisting.title: Use existing analysis
useExisting.description: Reuse the competitor insights you already have. Faster and no additional web searches.

runNew.title: Run new analysis
runNew.description: Perform fresh web searches to get updated competitor information. Takes longer.

skip.title: Skip competitor analysis
skip.description: Generate roadmap without any competitor insights.

competitorViewer.title: Competitor Analysis Results
competitorViewer.description: Analyzed {{competitors}} competitors to identify market gaps and opportunities

featureDetail.deleteFeatureDesc: This will permanently remove "{{title}}" from your roadmap.

addFeatureDialog.description: Add a new feature to your roadmap. Provide details about what you want to build and how it fits into your product strategy.

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: Describe what this feature does and why it's valuable to users.
